enc_text: After this report, {file} is created (AES-256, WinZip AES). It contains the original ZIP(s) with hash and timestamp files, log.csv and the reports. The SHA-256 of the copy is in {file}.sha256 and in the log of the case file. The password is not stored and is transmitted separately.
